scope: Finite conditional correspondence for offer preparation, recipient retirement and sender checkpoint confirmation, with actual process exits and fresh recovery.
public_inputs: public setup and original signed gateway requests
nondecreasing environment clock and dataset-independent fault schedule
generator_excludes: private records, seed and accumulator storage

plans.offer_histogram: first offer for one completed histogram
plans.retire_partial: retire first of ACCEPTED/100 and CLOSED/170 facts
plans.retire_duplicate: repeat retirement already accepted by receiver
plans.retire_second: retire second prefix after first checkpoint; replay older offer afterwards
plans.confirm_checkpoint: ACK loss followed by fresh CHECKPOINT query and confirmation
plans.confirm_retry: retry original confirmation request and receipt, including after recovery

unreachable: retire_duplicate does not execute after_v2_recipient_delete; exclude that pair.
observation_boundary: Includes trusted coordinator completions, business denials and recovery notifications as well as signed public traffic. Not a complete network attacker view.

events.confirmation_input: The request and receipt in a failed confirmation were known before this call, not leaked by the failure.

state_rules: Logical historical first facts are immutable; receiver floor selects live records without erasing sender archives.
Receiver retirement atomically updates floor/root/last_offer and removes the corresponding live rows.
Before witness acceptance restore previous authority; after acceptance restore the complete new image, even when local commit or reply is missing.
Repeated/stale offers return the current checkpoint and never reconstruct deleted facts or move floor backwards.
Authenticated FINAL/RETIRED and delivery replay business denials still persist observed time and a witness CAS.
A checkpoint at floor zero retains no sender retirement evidence.
No cleanup event refunds budget, resamples a mechanism or advances/rewinds the public FINAL prefix.

relations.R1-R4: Existing gateway, budget/draw, schedule and publication projections.
relations.R5: Explicit retirement metadata, checkpoint evidence and prepared offer map; original no-retirement assertions remain default.
relations.R6: Filtered live window, high/floor/root/last_offer, observed clock including business denials.
relations.R7-R8: Original sender archived confirmations and immutable FINAL prefix.
relations.R14: Child exit 97, authority/local atomicity, stale guard, unchanged other authorities, byte-exact fresh restoration, opaque sender archive/budget/final preservation.

domains.cleanup_starts: after all domain operations have final outcomes

negative_controls: ignoring receiver clock commit on rejection
modifying the retained opaque sender archive

cost_experiment.paired_comparison: same two jobs and outcomes, clean individually versus one batch
metrics: service method elapsed time without trace relation overhead
SQLite main/WAL/SHM/journal bytes, page and freelist counts
excludes: crash or restore in cost trials
peak I/O/memory, backup sizes or physical secure erasure

remaining: composed recovery interruptions and authority races

supplemental_batch_matrix.purpose: Connect same-workload two-row batching costs to actual recipient delete crash recovery using unchanged runtime/generator/relations.
supplemental_batch_matrix.coverage: All seven RETIRE_SEND cuts; query both rows immediately after recovery; no one-row intermediate state; retain sender archives.
